verses.original: Ἀναβλέψας δὲ εἶδεν τοὺς βάλλοντας εἰς τὸ γαζοφυλάκιον τὰ δῶρα αὐτῶν πλουσίους
verses.transliteration: Anablepsas de eiden tous ballontas eis to gazophylakion ta dōra autōn plousious
verses.literal: Then Jesus looked up and saw the rich putting their gifts into the treasury

verses.original: εἶδεν δέ τινα χήραν πενιχρὰν βάλλουσαν ἐκεῖ λεπτὰ δύο
verses.transliteration: eiden de tina chēran penichran ballousan ekei lepta dyo
verses.literal: and He saw a poor widow put in two small copper coins

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν Ἀληθῶς λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἡ χήρα αὕτη ἡ πτωχὴ πλεῖον πάντων ἔβαλεν
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen Alēthōs legō hymin hoti hē chēra hautē hē ptōchē pleion pantōn ebalen
verses.literal: Truly I tell you He said this poor widow has put in more than all the others

verses.original: πάντες γὰρ οὗτοι ἐκ τοῦ περισσεύοντος αὐτοῖς ἔβαλον εἰς τὰ δῶρα αὕτη δὲ ἐκ τοῦ ὑστερήματος αὐτῆς πάντα τὸν βίον ὃν εἶχεν ἔβαλεν
verses.transliteration: pantes gar houtoi ek tou perisseuontos autois ebalon eis ta dōra hautē de ek tou hysterēmatos autēs panta ton bion hon eichen ebalen
verses.literal: For they all . . . contributed . . . . . . . . . out of their surplus but she out of her poverty has put in all - she had to live on

verses.original: Καί τινων λεγόντων περὶ τοῦ ἱεροῦ ὅτι λίθοις καλοῖς καὶ ἀναθήμασιν κεκόσμηται εἶπεν
verses.transliteration: Kai tinōn legontōn peri tou hierou hoti lithois kalois kai anathēmasin kekosmētai eipen
verses.literal: As some of the disciples were remarking . . . how the temple was adorned with beautiful stones and consecrated gifts Jesus said

verses.original: Ταῦτα ἃ θεωρεῖτε ἐλεύσονται ἡμέραι ἐν αἷς οὐκ ἀφεθήσεται λίθος ἐπὶ λίθῳ ὃς οὐ καταλυθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Tauta ha theōreite eleusontai hēmerai en hais ouk aphethēsetai lithos epi lithō hos ou katalythēsetai
verses.literal: As for what you see here the time will come when not one stone will be left on another every one . . . will be thrown down

verses.original: Ἐπηρώτησαν δὲ αὐτὸν λέγοντες Διδάσκαλε πότε οὖν ταῦτα ἔσται καὶ τί τὸ σημεῖον ὅταν μέλλῃ ταῦτα γίνεσθαι
verses.transliteration: Epērōtēsan de auton legontes Didaskale pote oun tauta estai kai ti to sēmeion hotan mellē tauta ginesthai
verses.literal: Teacher they asked . . . . . . when will . . . these things happen And what will be the sign that they are about to take place

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Βλέπετε μὴ πλανηθῆτε πολλοὶ γὰρ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου λέγοντες Ἐγώ εἰμι καί Ὁ καιρὸς ἤγγικεν μὴ πορευθῆτε ὀπίσω αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen Blepete mē planēthēte polloi gar eleusontai epi tō onomati mou legontes Egō eimi kai Ho kairos ēngiken mē poreuthēte opisō autōn
verses.literal: Jesus answered See to it that you are not deceived For many will come in My name claiming I am He and The time is near Do not follow . . . them

verses.original: ὅταν δὲ ἀκούσητε πολέμους καὶ ἀκαταστασίας μὴ πτοηθῆτε δεῖ γὰρ ταῦτα γενέσθαι πρῶτον ἀλλ’ οὐκ εὐθέως τὸ τέλος
verses.transliteration: hotan de akousēte polemous kai akatastasias mē ptoēthēte dei gar tauta genesthai prōton all’ ouk eutheōs to telos
verses.literal: When you hear of wars and rebellions do not be alarmed These things must happen first but the end is not imminent

verses.original: Τότε ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Ἐγερθήσεται ἔθνος ἐπ’ ἔθνος καὶ βασιλεία ἐπὶ βασιλείαν
verses.transliteration: Tote elegen autois Egerthēsetai ethnos ep’ ethnos kai basileia epi basileian
verses.literal: Then He told them Nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom

verses.original: σεισμοί τε μεγάλοι καὶ κατὰ τόπους λιμοὶ καὶ λοιμοὶ ἔσονται φόβητρά τε καὶ ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ σημεῖα μεγάλα ἔσται
verses.transliteration: seismoi te megaloi kai kata topous limoi kai loimoi esontai phobētra te kai ap’ ouranou sēmeia megala estai
verses.literal: There will be great earthquakes famines and pestilences in various places along with fearful sights and great signs from heaven

verses.original: Πρὸ δὲ τούτων πάντων ἐπιβαλοῦσιν ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν καὶ διώξουσιν παραδιδόντες εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς καὶ φυλακάς ἀπαγομένους ἐπὶ βασιλεῖς καὶ ἡγεμόνας ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματός μου
verses.transliteration: Pro de toutōn pantōn epibalousin eph’ hymas tas cheiras autōn kai diōxousin paradidontes eis tas synagōgas kai phylakas apagomenous epi basileis kai hēgemonas heneken tou onomatos mou
verses.literal: But before all this they will seize . . . . . . . . . . . . you and persecute you On account of My name they will deliver you to the synagogues and prisons and they will bring you before kings and governors

verses.original: ἀποβήσεται ὑμῖν εἰς μαρτύριον
verses.transliteration: apobēsetai hymin eis martyrion
verses.literal: This will be your opportunity . . . to serve as witnesses

verses.original: θέτε οὖν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν μὴ προμελετᾶν ἀπολογηθῆναι
verses.transliteration: thete oun en tais kardiais hymōn mē promeletan apologēthēnai
verses.literal: So make up your mind not to worry beforehand how to defend yourselves

verses.original: ἐγὼ γὰρ δώσω ὑμῖν στόμα καὶ σοφίαν ᾗ οὐ δυνήσονται ἀντιστῆναι ἢ ἀντειπεῖν ἅπαντες οἱ ἀντικείμενοι ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: egō gar dōsō hymin stoma kai sophian hē ou dynēsontai antistēnai ē anteipein hapantes hoi antikeimenoi hymin
verses.literal: For I will give you speech and wisdom that none of . . . your adversaries . . . will be able to resist or contradict

verses.original: Παραδοθήσεσθε δὲ καὶ ὑπὸ γονέων καὶ ἀδελφῶν καὶ συγγενῶν καὶ φίλων καὶ θανατώσουσιν ἐξ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Paradothēsesthe de kai hypo goneōn kai adelphōn kai syngenōn kai philōn kai thanatōsousin ex hymōn
verses.literal: You will be betrayed even by parents and brothers and relatives and friends and some of you will be put to death

verses.original: καὶ ἔσεσθε μισούμενοι ὑπὸ πάντων διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου
verses.transliteration: kai esesthe misoumenoi hypo pantōn dia to onoma mou
verses.literal: And you will be hated by everyone because of My name

verses.original: καὶ θρὶξ ἐκ τῆς κεφαλῆς ὑμῶν οὐ μὴ ἀπόληται
verses.transliteration: kai thrix ek tēs kephalēs hymōn ou mē apolētai
verses.literal: Yet not even a hair of your head will perish

verses.original: ἐν τῇ ὑπομονῇ ὑμῶν κτήσασθε τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: en tē hypomonē hymōn ktēsasthe tas psychas hymōn
verses.literal: By your patient endurance you will gain your souls

verses.original: Ὅταν δὲ ἴδητε κυκλουμένην ὑπὸ στρατοπέδων Ἰερουσαλήμ τότε γνῶτε ὅτι ἤγγικεν ἡ ἐρήμωσις αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: Hotan de idēte kykloumenēn hypo stratopedōn Ierousalēm tote gnōte hoti ēngiken hē erēmōsis autēs
verses.literal: But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies you will know that her desolation is near

verses.original: τότε οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ φευγέτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὄρη καὶ οἱ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ἐκχωρείτωσαν καὶ οἱ ἐν ταῖς χώραις μὴ εἰσερχέσθωσαν εἰς αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: tote hoi en tē Ioudaia pheugetōsan eis ta orē kai hoi en mesō autēs ekchōreitōsan kai hoi en tais chōrais mē eiserchesthōsan eis autēn
verses.literal: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains let those in the city get out and let those in the country stay out of the city

verses.original: ὅτι ἡμέραι ἐκδικήσεως αὗταί εἰσιν τοῦ πλησθῆναι πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα
verses.transliteration: hoti hēmerai ekdikēseōs hautai eisin tou plēsthēnai panta ta gegrammena
verses.literal: For these are the days of vengeance to fulfill all that is written

verses.original: Οὐαὶ ταῖς ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσαις καὶ ταῖς θηλαζούσαις ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις ἔσται γὰρ ἀνάγκη μεγάλη ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὀργὴ τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ
verses.transliteration: Ouai tais en gastri echousais kai tais thēlazousais en ekeinais tais hēmerais estai gar anankē megalē epi tēs gēs kai orgē tō laō toutō
verses.literal: How miserable those days will be for pregnant . . . . . . and nursing mothers For there will be great distress upon the land and wrath against this people

verses.original: καὶ πεσοῦνται στόματι μαχαίρης καὶ αἰχμαλωτισθήσονται εἰς τὰ ἔθνη πάντα καὶ Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἔσται πατουμένη ὑπὸ ἐθνῶν ἄχρι οὗ πληρωθῶσιν καιροὶ ἐθνῶν
verses.transliteration: kai pesountai stomati machairēs kai aichmalōtisthēsontai eis ta ethnē panta kai Ierousalēm estai patoumenē hypo ethnōn achri hou plērōthōsin kairoi ethnōn
verses.literal: They will fall by the edge of the sword and be led captive into all the nations And Jerusalem will be trodden down by the Gentiles until . . . the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled

verses.original: Καὶ ἔσονται σημεῖα ἐν ἡλίῳ καὶ σελήνῃ καὶ ἄστροις καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς συνοχὴ ἐθνῶν ἐν ἀπορίᾳ ἤχους θαλάσσης καὶ σάλου
verses.transliteration: Kai esontai sēmeia en hēliō kai selēnē kai astrois kai epi tēs gēs synochē ethnōn en aporia ēchous thalassēs kai salou
verses.literal: There will be signs in the sun and moon and stars and on the earth dismay among the nations bewildered by the roaring of the sea and the surging of the waves

verses.original: ἀποψυχόντων ἀνθρώπων ἀπὸ φόβου καὶ προσδοκίας τῶν ἐπερχομένων τῇ οἰκουμένῃ αἱ γὰρ δυνάμεις τῶν οὐρανῶν σαλευθήσονται
verses.transliteration: apopsychontōn anthrōpōn apo phobou kai prosdokias tōn eperchomenōn tē oikoumenē hai gar dynameis tōn ouranōn saleuthēsontai
verses.literal: Men will faint from fear and anxiety over what is coming upon the earth for the powers of the heavens will be shaken

verses.original: καὶ τότε ὄψονται τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐν νεφέλῃ μετὰ δυνάμεως καὶ δόξης πολλῆς
verses.transliteration: kai tote opsontai ton Huion tou anthrōpou erchomenon en nephelē meta dynameōs kai doxēs pollēs
verses.literal: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory

verses.original: ἀρχομένων δὲ τούτων γίνεσθαι ἀνακύψατε καὶ ἐπάρατε τὰς κεφαλὰς ὑμῶν διότι ἐγγίζει ἡ ἀπολύτρωσις ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: archomenōn de toutōn ginesthai anakypsate kai eparate tas kephalas hymōn dioti engizei hē apolytrōsis hymōn
verses.literal: When these things begin to happen stand up and lift up your heads because your redemption is drawing near

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν παραβολὴν αὐτοῖς Ἴδετε τὴν συκῆν καὶ πάντα τὰ δένδρα
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen parabolēn autois Idete tēn sykēn kai panta ta dendra
verses.literal: Then Jesus told them a parable Look at the fig tree and all the trees

verses.original: ὅταν προβάλωσιν ἤδη βλέποντες ἀφ’ ἑαυτῶν γινώσκετε ὅτι ἤδη ἐγγὺς τὸ θέρος ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: hotan probalōsin ēdē blepontes aph’ heautōn ginōskete hoti ēdē engys to theros estin
verses.literal: When they sprout leaves . . . you can see for yourselves and know that summer is . . . near

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ὅταν ἴδητε ταῦτα γινόμενα γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγύς ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai hymeis hotan idēte tauta ginomena ginōskete hoti engys estin hē basileia tou Theou
verses.literal: So also when you see these things happening know that the kingdom of God is near

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη ἕως ἂν πάντα γένηται
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin hoti ou mē parelthē hē genea hautē heōs an panta genētai
verses.literal: Truly I tell you this generation will not pass away until . . . all these things have happened

verses.original: ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ παρελεύσονται οἱ δὲ λόγοι μου οὐ μὴ παρελεύσονται
verses.transliteration: ho ouranos kai hē gē pareleusontai hoi de logoi mou ou mē pareleusontai
verses.literal: Heaven and earth will pass away but My words will never pass away

verses.original: Προσέχετε δὲ ἑαυτοῖς μή‿ ποτε βαρηθῶσιν ὑμῶν αἱ καρδίαι ἐν κραιπάλῃ καὶ μέθῃ καὶ μερίμναις βιωτικαῖς καὶ ἐπιστῇ ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς αἰφνίδιος ἡ ἡμέρα ἐκείνη ὡς παγίς
verses.transliteration: Prosechete de heautois mē pote barēthōsin hymōn hai kardiai en kraipalē kai methē kai merimnais biōtikais kai epistē eph’ hymas aiphnidios hē hēmera ekeinē hōs pagis
verses.literal: But watch yourselves or . . . your hearts will be weighed down by dissipation drunkenness and the worries of life and that day will spring upon you suddenly like a snare

verses.original: ἐπεισελεύσεται γὰρ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς καθημένους ἐπὶ πρόσωπον πάσης τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: epeiseleusetai gar epi pantas tous kathēmenous epi prosōpon pasēs tēs gēs
verses.literal: For it will come upon all who dwell on the face of all the earth

verses.original: ἀγρυπνεῖτε δὲ ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ δεόμενοι ἵνα κατισχύσητε ἐκφυγεῖν ταῦτα πάντα τὰ μέλλοντα γίνεσθαι καὶ σταθῆναι ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: agrypneite de en panti kairō deomenoi hina katischysēte ekphygein tauta panta ta mellonta ginesthai kai stathēnai emprosthen tou Huiou tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: So keep watch at all times and pray that you may have the strength to escape all that is about to happen and to stand before the Son of Man

verses.original: Ἦν δὲ τὰς ἡμέρας ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ διδάσκων τὰς δὲ νύκτας ἐξερχόμενος ηὐλίζετο εἰς τὸ ὄρος τὸ καλούμενον Ἐλαιῶν
verses.transliteration: Ēn de tas hēmeras en tō hierō didaskōn tas de nyktas exerchomenos ēulizeto eis to oros to kaloumenon Elaiōn
verses.literal: Every day Jesus taught at the temple but every evening He went out to spend the night on the Mount of Olives

verses.original: καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὤρθριζεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἀκούειν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai pas ho laos ōrthrizen pros auton en tō hierō akouein autou
verses.literal: And early in the morning - all the people would come to hear Him at the temple
